name: BuildZoom

sources.title: Contractor help (search-indexed) — profiles and leads are free; active license verified against state/regulatory data required; referral fee only on signed contracts
For Contractors (search-indexed) — create a business profile, set job preferences, agree to referral agreement; ~2.5% referral fee when hired

conditions: Profiles and leads are free, but the platform requires an active contractor license verifiable via state/licensing-board data — licensed contractors start with a BZ score of 90
Not applicable to SaaS/software — BuildZoom lists general contractors, remodelers and home builders; skip unless the 'product' is a licensed contracting business
A 2.5% referral fee applies to contracts won through the platform
requirements: Active contractor license that BuildZoom can verify against public license-board data
Business name + zip code for the claim/add lookup — many contractors are pre-listed from public data
preparation: Business name, zip code, service radius, services offered
Portfolio photos and client reviews to build the BZ score
workflow: Open buildzoom.com in a browser and click 'Contractor Sign Up' (site 403s automated fetches)
Search business name + zip: 'Claim this business' if pre-listed, else 'Add your business to BuildZoom'
Enter email to join; verify contact info; add license details and portfolio
Maintain the profile — BZ score (license status, reviews, responsiveness) drives lead flow
watchFor: No SaaS/software listing surface — licensed trades only
Unlicensed or lapsed-license businesses show a BZ score below 90 or can't be listed
Optional paid upgrades (~$99/mo advertising tier per third-party sources) exist but aren't required
The referral fee triggers only on signed contracts sourced via BuildZoom
countsAsLive: A claimed public contractor profile on buildzoom.com showing license status and BZ score
unknowns: Verification turnaround for new adds without pre-seeded license data
Whether profile website links are present/dofollow
Current upgrade plan pricing (only a third-party ~$99/mo figure seen)
